description: Canonical label contract shared by the web (JS) and TUI (Ruby) suites: the words both UIs put on the same event. One source of truth: edit this file to change either side's words and BOTH suites must still pass. A case with "expected" is the same on both sides; one with "ruby" / "js" pins where the two UIs differ on purpose (the line around the label is each UI's own: the TUI's "x>" rows, the web's bubbles). Ruby: spec/labels_matrix_spec.rb; JS: spec/web/public/labels_matrix.test.js.

cancel_reasons.note: The label a canceled turn's line ends with, in parentheses (Formatting#turn_canceled_line: "■ turn canceled (label)"; timing.js cancelLineText: "■ canceled (label)"); null: no parentheses. "mark" starts both lines (and the cancelled_by ones): a stop someone chose, not an error's ✕ (that stays a failed turn's and a worker that exited).

cancelled_by.note: A canceled turn's line with who stopped it (turn_canceled's cancelled_by, the turn record's too): the words after the mark (Formatting#turn_canceled_line: "<mark> turn <words>"; timing.js cancelLineText: "<mark> <words>"; mark: cancel_reasons'). Only a hook's stop names one; no one: the cancel_reasons line.

client_labels.note: The label on a prompt by its sender's client_id, whole or by prefix (Formatting#prompt_line "label> prompt"; turn_events.js clientLabel). An id chi doesn't know is automatic, never the user. No client_id: the TUI's history/own prompt shows user>, the web's own bubble has no label.

hook_notice_labels.note: Who a hook's notice is from (EventRenderer.hook_notice_line "label> text"; turn_events.js hookNoticeLabel, shown "label: text").

empty_retry_lines.note: The row a step gets when the loop asks again (Formatting#format_empty_retry_line; turn_events.js emptyRetryLine).

steer_cut_lines.note: The row a step gets when a message for the running turn cut a generation that was only thinking (Formatting#format_steer_cut_line; turn_events.js steerCutLine). An empty or unknown source is the user.

cases.expected: ↪ cut in for a message sent with chi send
↪ cut in for the parent agent's message

steer_senders.note: Who a steer row names as its sender (Formatting#steer_sender, the TUI's "<who>> nudged: …"; format.js steerSender, the web's "<who> nudged the model"): a plugin's label as is, chi's sender ids in words (plugin_send, ctx.sessions.send: "plugin"; user stays as is). No source: the TUI says "plugin", the web names no one.

empty_answer_lines.note: The one muted line every UI shows for a turn that ended with no answer (TurnNote.empty_answer_line, Formatting#format_empty_answer_line; turn_events.js emptyAnswerLine).

cases.expected: no answer: the model returned nothing
no answer: the model returned nothing (after 1 retry)
no answer: the model returned nothing (after 3 retries)

retry_lines.note: The live status while the provider is asked again (generation_retrying): Formatting#format_generation_retry_line; turn_events.js retryStatusLine. Both count the retry of all retries (1/3); the wording around it differs.

reminder_lines.note: The line for the reminders a turn got (Formatting#reminder_line; turn_events.js reminderText).

served_model.note: Whether the served model is another one than the name asked (ServedModel.differs?; format.js servedModelDiffers).

speeds.note: A decode speed (Formatting#speed_text in /stats; ctx.js speedText in the web's info bar): "~" marks an estimate (no server timings); none or zero: "".

costs.note: A cost in USD (Formatting#cost_text in /stats; ctx.js costText in the ctx tooltip): cents, four decimals under a cent; "~" marks an estimate (hosts.<name>.models prices); none or zero: "".

memory_index.note: The memory indexes a session's prompt holds (the snapshot's memory_index; Formatting#memory_index_text after "memory index:" in /stats; ctx.js memoryIndexText in the ctx tooltip): the total, then each scope; a count from 1000 in k with one decimal; a scope missing is left out; none: "".

cases.expected: ~3.4k tokens in this session's prompt (system 2.0k, project 1.4k)
~456 tokens in this session's prompt (system 450, project 6)

prompt_notes.note: The model notes a session's prompt carried (its prompt_notes: name, scope, chars, digest; PromptNote.text after "model notes:" in /stats, "; notes: " in /model and chi self's model notes row; format.js promptNotesText in the info bar's notes chip tooltip): each note's name with its scope and size, comma-separated; a part missing is left out; none: "".
